title: Announce milestone
description: Funding rounds, ARR, star counts, user counts, acquisitions: the number-hit choreography (a 1.2 to 1.6 second count-up, then hold, label after value), what actually earns a milestone video, the gratitude beat, and investor or customer logo walls. Load it when the ask is a number going up, with no feature to demonstrate. Not this skill when there is a product to show: use launch-playbook or announce-feature instead.
summary: Funding, ARR, star counts, users. The count-up choreography, the gratitude beat, and what actually earns a video.

requires.why: The what-it-means and gratitude lines, when the cut is narrated.
Real contributor, customer or investor logos.
The count-up hold and digit stability are judged by looking.

route.deliverable: A 15–30 second celebration of one number: users, stars, revenue, a funding round
askFirst: What is the number, and when was it hit?

models.note: Warm, not triumphant. The number does the work.

triggers: we just hit a funding milestone, make a video
make a video about our ARR
we got acquired, need a video
